warmup_source.policy: Accepted history age (TemporalFrame.samples, u8) advances only in TemporalState::accept; a frame without previous history restarts at 1 and a bypassed frame at 0; it saturates at 100. TemporalSystem::prepare writes options.x = Pending::history_weight() = 0 for samples <= 1, else min(configured history_weight, (samples - 1) / samples). Shader source, bindings, resource limits and the configured weight are unchanged.

probe.purpose: Adapter/backend identity, temporal pipeline enablement and idempotence, validation of the review config and rejection of five invalid configs, availability of the timing constructor. No frame.

stationary.purpose: Static look-dev stage (ground at grazing angles, sphere and cube silhouettes, thin post and wall, 19 receding fence posts, one-texel MASK grille card): one temporal-off reference, then 16 frames = two full 8-phase jitter cycles; activity map over frames 9-16.

motion.purpose: 8 frames of a bright cube crossing in front of the thin wall towards the sphere (about 21 px/frame, revealing disoccluded background), off reference; then a fresh owner and 6 frames of lateral camera pan with yaw (parallax), off reference.

excluded.purpose: Opaque checker backdrop that accumulates, BLEND card, three sprites and world text that are current-only and jittered, plus a screen-space UI button over uniform sky after every world frame: one 8-phase cycle and an off reference.

transitions.purpose: 6 frames of view A, explicit cut to view B (2 frames), fixed half-scale dynamic resolution (3 frames), output scale again (1 frame), off reference of view B. Checks phase/history/epoch/extent resets and one owner.

skinned.purpose: The skeletal fixture used by the passing motion test, clip 1 (second joint rotation, two vertices deform) at 0.0-0.5 s over 6 frames in front of a checker backdrop, orthographic camera, off reference.

timing.purpose: Timing-enabled device: the stationary stage alternates a temporal-off and a temporal-on owner for 4 pairs; each frame's sample must exist and be well formed, and the median Models span must grow when the motion, resolve and copy passes are encoded inside it.

viewport.purpose: New for this comparison: the stationary stage in an integer-offset, odd-sized viewport [37, 19, 885, 501] inside the 960x540 output (also the temporal rect at full scale). Temporal-off at the still pose; one owner accumulates 16 still frames (two cycles, activity bands over frames 9-16 recorded in the report), then 8 frames of lateral pan with yaw that carry content across the viewport border; temporal-off at the final pan pose. Outside the viewport every frame must equal the reference surround.

comparison.note: Thresholds are fixed-sharpness-design.md proposals plus every earlier coverage, ghost, reset and overlay constraint, byte-identical to the a143b5c0 comparison (plan c874115d) and not relaxed. They are not plan gates. The accepted baseline is reused only when the comparison is exact; the viewport case has no baseline and uses absolute bounds. The rejected a143b5c0 run is a second exact reference for the effect of the one ramp change, never a threshold.

sharpness.source: fixed-sharpness-design.md: grille detail >= 50% of reference; effective sigma <= 0.6 px in the five regions (stationary on-f16 against temporal-off, linear light)

stability.source: design: 33+ activity <= 2 x 159, none saturated, edge mean frames 9-16 <= 5, no pixel more than 2 steps above the reference's local 3x3 maximum; corrected-visual-result.md: edge max <= 50, interiors <= 100 changed per frame, same-phase f8/f16 interior 0

ghosts.rule: each off-edge bin (3-8, 9-16, >16 steps at >= 3 px from any edge) no worse than the baseline run
ghosts.pairing_gate: explicit nonzero-jitter moving-edge/depth-pairing gate (review eb5ff0a1): the moving cube's trailing 1 px band within 1.1 x its top-edge control and no worse than the baseline's, object off-edge bins no worse than the baseline's, and the viewport pan border and off-edge rules

viewport.rules: still and pan: the 3 px border band's non-edge max difference may not exceed the inner viewport's; pan f24: no off-edge difference of 9 steps or more; outside the viewport: identical to the reference
viewport.note: candidate-only proposals: no baseline exists for this new case

prior.role: Exactness (manifest, files, identity, recorded failures, temporal-off frames, adapter, toolchain, review config) gates the comparison. Every quality check is also evaluated on the prior run with the same code; its recomputed failures must equal the recorded 13. history_free_frames.rule: Every frame a report records as temporal with has_previous false and not bypassed (the first frame of each owner and every cut, DRS or output-scale reset) must have the same rgba_sha256 as the same-named frame of the prior run (11 frames) and, where the case exists there, of the baseline (10 frames).
history_free_frames.derivation: A frame without previous history has samples = 1, so options.x = 0, and the shader returns registered_current before any blend (frame.depth.w < 0.5): the ramp cannot change it. The retained baseline and prior runs already agree on all 10 shared frames (measured from their report hashes).
